notes: 256 kB RAM across 9 AHB slaves: slaves 0-7 each two 4 kB sections, slave 8 six 32 kB sections. The same physical RAM is mapped to both the Code RAM and Data RAM regions, not two separate 256 kB pools. total_flash_bytes (1024 kB) and the revision/page above are confirmed from the same sentence in the official PDF edition of this document ("The nRF52840 contains 1024 kB of flash memory and 256 kB of RAM that can be used for code and data storage", Section 4.2 Memory, page 21, v1.11) -- the PDF was fetched directly since source.url (the HTML bundle page) blocks direct automated fetches; page/revision refer to that PDF, not the HTML page.
